## Fixes

- **Blitz** showed Expresso's headlines. Blitz now lives under expresso.pt/blitz, and the old blitz.pt feed redirected to Expresso's main feed. Tabloid now reads Blitz from Expresso's site and keeps only articles whose link is under `/blitz`.
- **Stereogum** didn't load. Feeds with stray whitespace or control characters before the XML are now cleaned before parsing, and `stereogum.com` without `www` is allowed in case the feed redirects there.

## New

- **Consequence** (formerly Consequence of Sound) added to the Music column, using its news feed.
- **Clearer errors:** when a source fails, its error line lists each URL tried and why it failed, so you can fix it in `feeds.js` straight from the message.
- Sources can now have a `match` setting in `feeds.js` to keep only matching links, for feeds shared between publications.

## Upgrade

Download **`tabloid-v1.5.0.zip`** below (not "Source code"), replace your `tabloid` folder, and click reload on the extension's card in `chrome://extensions`. If you cloned the repo, run `git pull` and reload instead. Chrome may ask to approve access to consequence.net.
